content: Spend even a little time online in gaming circles, and you'll inevitably come across claims that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is one of the greatest games ever made. Those claims resurfaced with greater frequency with the announcement of the Nintendo Switch 2 Ocarina of Time remake and subsequent warm reception from critics. The reaction from those I know who played for the first time and enjoyed it has generally been "yes, it really is one of the greats." What there's been less of, however, is a concerted effort to explain what exactly makes it deserving of that praise. Make no mistake, it does deserve it — and not just for reasons of nostalgia. That’s because Ocarina of Time anticipated some of gaming's biggest trends, and now that those trends have spiralled out of control, the remake serves as a blueprint for good game design moving forward.
